title: Nell's Noisy Hive
note: b385 — first use of 'jam_jar'. Tall sunflowers behind the hive reuse the existing 'flower' prop at a larger scale rather than a new dedicated prop. 'A tiny puff of dust' on p2 reuses 'mud_splash' scaled small rather than inventing a dust-specific prop.

pages.brief: Nell the sunflower-yellow bumblebee hovering in front of a tidy hive behind tall sunflowers, holding an empty jam jar like a conductor holding nothing. Bright, busy, comic. Her tuft of fluff sticks up with effort.
pages.alt: Nell the bee hovers in front of a tidy hive behind tall sunflowers, holding an empty jam jar like a conductor, her tuft of fluff sticking up with effort.

pages.brief: Two dry twigs held in Nell's front legs, striking together. Draw the moment of contact with a tiny puff of dust. Sunflower stems make warm vertical stripes behind her.
pages.alt: Nell strikes two dry twigs together, a tiny puff of dust at the moment of contact, tall sunflower stems making warm vertical stripes behind her.

pages.brief: A dented tin can lying on its side; Nell drumming the base with both front legs. Show the first BOOM with the tin tipping over and a startled ladybird flying off it. Playful chaos.
pages.alt: A dented tin can lies on its side as Nell drums its base with both front legs, the first BOOM sending a startled ladybird flying off it in playful chaos.

pages.brief: Ned the gold duckling at the reedy pond edge, one webbed foot down flat, a wide flat splash ring spreading out. Water droplets caught in the air. Ned looks extremely pleased with himself.
pages.alt: Ned the duckling slaps the reedy pond edge with one flat webbed foot, a wide splash ring spreading out and water droplets caught in the air, looking extremely pleased with himself.

pages.brief: Nell mid-air with all six legs in different positions, a blur of movement lines. Ned watching with his beak open. Keep the composition diagonal so it feels fast.
pages.alt: Nell spins in mid-air with all six legs in different positions, a diagonal blur of movement lines, while Ned watches with his beak open.

pages.brief: Nell frozen with one leg raised like a conductor's baton, everyone else caught mid-stop: Ned's foot half lifted, the tin still rocking. Very still composition, lots of white space, the opposite of the previous page.
pages.alt: Nell is frozen with one leg raised like a conductor's baton, Ned's foot half lifted and the tin still rocking — a very still, quiet composition.

pages.brief: Simple, calm final page. Nell sitting on the upturned tin at dusk with Ned beside her, both looking out at the darkening garden. Warm low light. No movement lines anywhere.
pages.alt: A calm closing page: Nell sits on the upturned tin at dusk with Ned beside her, both looking out at the darkening garden in warm low light.
